# Web Analytics Reporter

Web Analytics Reporter is an open source Node.js package for scheduled website analytics reports.

Primary URL: https://web-analytics-reporter.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/pntech20/web-analytics-reporter
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/web-analytics-reporter

## What it does

- Reads GA4 reporting data through the Google Analytics Data API.
- Sends daily summaries to Telegram.
- Runs well from Vercel Cron and serverless API routes.
- Supports multiple websites from one endpoint.
- Reports users, sessions, page views, countries, sources, pages, and custom events.

## Common questions answered

- How do I send GA4 reports to Telegram?
- How do I run Google Analytics reports from Vercel Cron?
- How do I monitor multiple GA4 properties from one endpoint?
- How do I send daily website analytics summaries to a team chat?
